dm_aviso_titulo: Always keep your phone with you
dm_aviso_texto:
During the service, CuidApp uses your phone's motion sensors to detect falls or accidents.

If we detect a strong impact and you do not move, we will ask you to confirm you are OK. If you do not respond within 30 seconds, we will automatically alert the CuidApp team and your emergency contact.

Always keep it with you; do not leave it somewhere else.

tyc_intro: Please read carefully. You must reach the end to accept or decline.
tyc_hint: Scroll to the end to continue
tyc_1_b: By creating an account on CuidApp you accept these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, you will not be able to sign up or use the app.
tyc_2_b: CuidApp is a platform that connects clients with caregivers and home service providers (cleaning, child care and elder care). CuidApp facilitates contact, coordination and payment, but it is not the caregivers' employer.
tyc_3_b: You must be of legal age and provide true and up-to-date information. Caregivers must submit identity and background documents that CuidApp reviews before approving their account. You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for all activity on your account.
tyc_4_b: The caregiver agrees to keep the agreed schedule, treat clients and their families with respect, start and finish the service with the PIN codes, not share the client's private information and carry their phone with them throughout the service.
tyc_5_b: The client agrees to provide a correct address and details, ensure a safe environment, confirm the completion of the service and not request illegal activities or activities outside the contracted service.
tyc_6_b: The client pays the agreed rate for the service and, when it ends, may leave an optional tip. Payments to caregivers are reviewed and authorized by the administration. Cancellations and disputed payments are evaluated case by case, and frequent cancellations may affect your account.
tyc_7_b: During a service you can use the SOS button. To protect caregivers, the app uses the phone's motion sensors to detect possible falls and, if you do not confirm you are OK, it alerts the CuidApp team and your emergency contact. In a real emergency you must also call 911.
tyc_8_b: We use your location during services (for example, to verify that the caregiver arrived at the address), your documents to verify your identity and your messages to coordinate the service and provide support. Your data is used only to operate CuidApp and is handled in accordance with the data protection law of the Dominican Republic. We do not sell your data.
tyc_9_b: CuidApp may suspend or close accounts for fraud, false information, mistreatment, repeated non-compliance or misuse of the platform, including misuse of the SOS button or the chat.
tyc_10_b: We may update these terms and will notify you of important changes. If you have questions, write to us from Support in the app.

faq_aceptar_p: How do I accept a request?
faq_aceptar_r: When a client requests a service you get a notification. Open it or go to See jobs, check the date, time and address, and tap Accept or Reject.
faq_pin_r: It proves you arrived. When you get there, the client tells you the 4-digit PIN shown in their app and you enter it to start the service. Without the PIN the service can't start.
faq_no_confirma_p: What if the client doesn't confirm I finished?
faq_no_confirma_r: When you mark the end, the client has to confirm it. If they say no, the service goes back to «in progress» and we let you know. Talk to them about what was missing; if you can't agree, report it to support and we'll review it.
faq_cancelar_p: How do I cancel a service?
faq_cancelar_r: Open the service details and tap Cancel service. Choose the reason; the client is notified right away. Only cancel if you really can't go.
faq_cobro_p: When do I get paid for a service?
faq_cobro_r: The payment is created when the client confirms you finished. Then the CuidApp team authorizes it and sends it with your payout method. You can follow it all in My money.
faq_estados_p: What does each payment status mean?
faq_estados_r: Pending: the service ended and we're reviewing it. Authorized: it's approved and on its way. Paid: we already sent it. If something looks off, report it from here.
faq_propina_r: The client can leave you a tip when confirming the end of the service. The tip is all yours and is added to that service's payment.
faq_visible_r: Check that: your visibility is on (or you're within your schedule), your account is approved and CuidApp has location permission. Clients see Care Partners near the service address.
faq_modos_r: In manual mode you turn your visibility on and off from your dashboard. In schedule mode we make you visible and hide you automatically based on My schedule; while it's on you can't change it by hand.
faq_segundo_plano_p: Why should I keep the app in the background?
faq_segundo_plano_r: That way requests, messages and schedule notices reach you instantly. Leave with the home button instead of closing it, and if your phone has battery saver, allow CuidApp to run in the background.
faq_rechazado_p: A document was rejected, what do I do?
faq_rechazado_r: On the verification screen you'll see why it was rejected. Tap the document, upload a new clear photo and we'll review it again.
faq_verificacion_r: We review your documents as soon as possible. We'll let you know in the app when your account is approved; meanwhile you can open your dashboard but can't go visible yet.
faq_datos_p: How do I change my details?
faq_datos_r: Tap your photo at the top of the dashboard to open your profile. There you can change your emergency contact, language and theme. To change your photo, name or other details, report it to support.
faq_sos_p: How does the SOS button work?
faq_sos_r: During a service you have an SOS button. When you use it, the CuidApp team instantly gets an alert with your location and your emergency contact's details so we can help you.
faq_caidas_r: During a service, if the phone detects a hard impact and then you don't move, it asks if you're okay. If you don't answer within 30 seconds, we send an automatic SOS alert.
faq_contacto_p: What is the emergency contact for?
faq_contacto_r: It's the person we call if something happens to you during a service. Keep it up to date from your profile.
ayuda_whatsapp_mensaje: Hi, I'm a CuidApp Care Partner and I need help with:
ayuda_no_se_pudo_abrir: We couldn't open that option on your phone. Write to us with Report a problem.
checkin_error: We couldn't send your answer. Check your connection and try again.
checkin_gracias_texto: We let the CuidApp team know you're okay.
checkin_ayuda_texto: The CuidApp team got an alert with your location and will contact you. If it's a serious emergency, call 911.
